'When this hits, create an Embodiment of Earth token.' Earth Action - Attack.

Shape copied from sibling drafts .drafts/earth_form_red.json and .drafts/earth_form_yellow.json after re-verifying every claim against the handlers myself.

Trigger: ON_HIT is a real trigger name (trigger_types.py line 6 maps it to the engine's ON_HIT event) and it is dispatched to the attack card's own slug, so the attacking copy receives its own hit trigger - no hero routing needed. An attack action card is not an ATTACK_REACTION, so TRIGGERED + ON_HIT on the card itself is the shape.

Effect: CREATE_TOKEN handler (effect_types.py ~1942) reads 'token' as a slug ('token_name'/'token_type' accepted interchangeably; the slug spelling is what shipped cards use), count/amount defaults to 1 - correct for 'an ... token' - and player defaults to SELF, i.e. the attack's controller. No destination override: entry-zone routing derives from the token's card-DB template subtypes, which is correct for an Embodiment ally. json/tokens/embodiment_of_earth.json exists with the matching slug, so resolution will not raise MissingCardImplementation.

No printed keywords on this card, so nothing is deliberately omitted. No gaps found.
